name: Nike Dunk Low Premium 'Oil Green'
story_html: The Nike Dunk Low Premium ‘Oil Green’ showcases natural olive hues on an upper that blends a breathable textile base with smooth nubuck overlays. Pale green accents distinguish the branding elements, including the signature Swoosh and woven Nike tongue tag. Underpinning the low-top is a durable rubber cupsole, featuring stitched sidewall construction and an interior foam wedge. Underfoot, the rubber outsole utilizes a traction pattern originally designed to grip the hardwood in all directions.
